════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 迁移兜底：v1.2.7 训练录像导出（浏览器控制台脚本）
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

适用场景：「导出训练录像.cmd」打不开、端口被占、或页面提示找不到录像库时使用。

使用步骤：
  1. 正常启动旧版训练器（Start.cmd），等页面完全打开；
  2. 在训练器页面上按 F12（或右键→检查）打开开发者工具，切到「控制台 / Console」；
  3. 复制本文件分隔线以下的【全部内容】粘贴进控制台，回车执行；
  4. 浏览器会自动下载「训练录像库-….trainer-recordings.json」，即迁移合并包；
  5. 打开 v1.3.0 →「训练录像」→「导入录制」，选择该文件完成迁移。

说明：脚本只读取录像、不修改不删除任何旧数据；导出后控制台会逐条列出结果。

────────────────── 以下为脚本内容，复制到控制台 ──────────────────

"use strict";
(() => {
  // web/src/recording/compactCodec.ts
  var MAX_DELTA_CHAIN = 31;
  var READER_CACHE_LIMIT = 8;
  function clone(value) {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  }
  function canonicalJson(value) {
    if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return JSON.stringify(value) ?? "null";
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map((item) => canonicalJson(item)).join(",")}]`;
    const entries = Object.entries(value).filter(([, v]) => v !== void 0);
    entries.sort(([a], [b]) => a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
    return `{${entries.map(([k, v]) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJson(v)}`).join(",")}}`;
  }
  function fingerprint(canonical) {
    let hash = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < canonical.length; i += 1) {
      hash ^= canonical.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }
    return `${(hash >>> 0).toString(16)}:${canonical.length}`;
  }
  function applyDelta(base, upsert, remove, keyOf) {
    const result = base.slice();
    const indexByKey = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    result.forEach((item, i) => indexByKey.set(keyOf(item), i));
    for (const item of upsert) {
      const key = keyOf(item);
      const at = indexByKey.get(key);
      if (at === void 0) {
        indexByKey.set(key, result.length);
        result.push(item);
      } else {
        result[at] = item;
      }
    }
    if (remove.length) {
      const drop = new Set(remove);
      return result.filter((item) => !drop.has(keyOf(item)));
    }
    return result;
  }
  function sameKeySequence(items, keys, keyOf) {
    if (items.length !== keys.length) return false;
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
      if (keyOf(items[i]) !== keys[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function sortedByDrawId(items) {
    return items.slice().sort((a, b) => a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);
  }
  function deriveAsOf(checkpoint) {
    const training = checkpoint.training;
    if (!training) return null;
    if (training.training.currentDate !== null) return training.training.currentDate;
    return training.training.blind ? null : training.training.startDate;
  }
  function buildState(items, keyOf) {
    return { items, index: new Map(items.map((item, i) => [keyOf(item), i])) };
  }
  function expandVersionChain(id, byId, label, cache, materializeBase, applyVersion) {
    const cached = cache.get(id);
    if (cached !== void 0) return cached;
    const chain = [];
    const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    let current = byId.get(id);
    if (!current) throw new Error(`checkpoint\u5F15\u7528\u7684${label}\u7248\u672C ${id} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\uFF0C\u6587\u4EF6\u53EF\u80FD\u635F\u574F`);
    for (; ; ) {
      if (seen.has(current.id)) throw new Error(`${label}\u57FA\u7840\u94FE\u5B58\u5728\u5FAA\u73AF\u5F15\u7528\uFF1A${current.id}`);
      seen.add(current.id);
      chain.push(current);
      if (current.base === null) break;
      const next = byId.get(current.base);
      if (!next) throw new Error(`${label}\u7248\u672C ${current.id} \u5F15\u7528\u7684\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C ${current.base} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\uFF0C\u6587\u4EF6\u53EF\u80FD\u635F\u574F`);
      current = next;
    }
    chain.reverse();
    let start = 0;
    let hit;
    for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const ancestor = cache.get(chain[i].id);
      if (ancestor !== void 0) {
        hit = ancestor;
        start = i + 1;
        break;
      }
    }
    let items;
    if (hit !== void 0) {
      items = hit;
    } else {
      const root = chain[0];
      items = materializeBase(root);
      cache.set(root.id, items);
      start = 1;
    }
    for (let i = start; i < chain.length; i += 1) {
      const version = chain[i];
      items = version.base === null ? materializeBase(version) : applyVersion(items, version);
      cache.set(version.id, items);
    }
    return items;
  }
  var CompactBuilder = class {
    resources;
    checkpointCount;
    seriesIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    seriesHeads = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    seriesStates = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    seriesDeltaCounts = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    /** 周期 → 指纹 → 版本id（历史内容复用查找；仅存id不存展开内容） */
    seriesFpIndex = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    drawingsById = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    drawingsHead = null;
    drawingsState = null;
    drawingsDeltaCount = 0;
    drawingsFpIndex = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    /** 历史复用比对时的临时展开缓存（有界，不作为持久索引） */
    seriesReconstructCache = new LruCache(READER_CACHE_LIMIT);
    drawingsReconstructCache = new LruCache(READER_CACHE_LIMIT);
    nextSeriesId = 1;
    nextDrawingId = 1;
    metaTable;
    accountTable;
    tradeTable;
    contextTable;
    constructor(resources, checkpointCount = 0) {
      this.resources = resources ? clone(resources) : { series: [], drawings: [], trainingMeta: [], accounts: [], trades: [], contexts: [] };
      this.checkpointCount = checkpointCount;
      for (const version of this.resources.series) this.indexRestoredSeries(version);
      for (const version of this.resources.drawings) {
        if (this.drawingsById.has(version.id)) throw new Error(`\u753B\u7EBF\u7248\u672Cid\u91CD\u590D\uFF1A${version.id}`);
        this.drawingsById.set(version.id, version);
      }
      if (this.resources.drawings.length) {
        this.drawingsHead = this.resources.drawings[this.resources.drawings.length - 1].id;
        this.drawingsDeltaCount = this.walkDeltaCount(this.drawingsHead, "drawings");
      }
      for (const headId of this.seriesHeads.values()) this.seriesDepth(headId);
      for (const version of this.resources.series) {
        const numbered = version.id.match(/^s(\d+)$/);
        if (numbered) this.nextSeriesId = Math.max(this.nextSeriesId, Number(numbered[1]) + 1);
      }
      for (const version of this.resources.drawings) {
        const numbered = version.id.match(/^dw(\d+)$/);
        if (numbered) this.nextDrawingId = Math.max(this.nextDrawingId, Number(numbered[1]) + 1);
      }
      this.metaTable = this.restoreTable("m", this.resources.trainingMeta);
      this.accountTable = this.restoreTable("a", this.resources.accounts);
      this.tradeTable = this.restoreTable("t", this.resources.trades);
      this.contextTable = this.restoreTable("x", this.resources.contexts);
      this.rebuildContentIndexes();
    }
    indexRestoredSeries(version) {
      if (this.seriesIds.has(version.id)) throw new Error(`\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672Cid\u91CD\u590D\uFF1A${version.id}`);
      this.seriesIds.set(version.id, version);
      this.seriesHeads.set(version.timeframe, version.id);
    }
    restoreTable(prefix, entries) {
      const table = {
        prefix,
        entries,
        ids: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(),
        nextId: 1,
        byId: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),
        byFingerprint: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()
      };
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.id || table.ids.has(entry.id)) throw new Error(`\u8D44\u6E90id\u4E3A\u7A7A\u6216\u91CD\u590D\uFF1A${entry.id}`);
        table.ids.add(entry.id);
        table.byId.set(entry.id, entry);
        const fp = fingerprint(canonicalJson(entry.value));
        const bucket = table.byFingerprint.get(fp);
        if (bucket) bucket.push(entry.id);
        else table.byFingerprint.set(fp, [entry.id]);
        const numbered = entry.id.match(/^([a-z]+)(\d+)$/);
        if (numbered && numbered[1] === prefix) table.nextId = Math.max(table.nextId, Number(numbered[2]) + 1);
      }
      return table;
    }
    /** 计算某版本所在链的增量层数（带缓存） */
    walkDeltaCount(leafId, kind) {
      let count = 0;
      const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      let current = leafId;
      for (; ; ) {
        if (seen.has(current)) throw new Error(`${kind === "series" ? "\u884C\u60C5" : "\u753B\u7EBF"}\u57FA\u7840\u94FE\u5B58\u5728\u5FAA\u73AF\u5F15\u7528\uFF1A${current}`);
        seen.add(current);
        const version = kind === "series" ? this.seriesIds.get(current) : this.drawingsById.get(current);
        if (!version) throw new Error(`${kind === "series" ? "\u884C\u60C5" : "\u753B\u7EBF"}\u7248\u672C\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\uFF1A${current}`);
        if (version.base === null) break;
        count += 1;
        current = version.base;
      }
      return count;
    }
    seriesDepth(id) {
      const known = this.seriesDeltaCounts.get(id);
      if (known !== void 0) return known;
      const depth = this.walkDeltaCount(id, "series");
      this.seriesDeltaCounts.set(id, depth);
      return depth;
    }
    /** 恢复后按追加序滚动重建内容指纹索引：每版本规范化一次即弃，不保留展开历史 */
    rebuildContentIndexes() {
      const rollingItems = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      const rollingHead = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      for (const version of this.resources.series) {
        let items;
        const prevHead = rollingHead.get(version.timeframe);
        if (version.base === null) {
          items = version.bars.slice();
        } else if (prevHead === version.base) {
          items = applyDelta(rollingItems.get(version.timeframe), version.upsert, version.remove, (bar) => bar.date);
        } else {
          items = this.expandSeriesVersion(version.id);
        }
        this.pushSeriesFingerprint(version.timeframe, fingerprint(arrayCanonical(items)), version.id);
        rollingItems.set(version.timeframe, items);
        rollingHead.set(version.timeframe, version.id);
      }
      let prevDrawingsHead = null;
      let drawingsItems = [];
      for (const version of this.resources.drawings) {
        if (version.base === null) {
          drawingsItems = version.items.slice();
        } else if (prevDrawingsHead === version.base) {
          drawingsItems = sortedByDrawId(
            applyDelta(drawingsItems, version.upsert, version.remove, (drawing) => drawing.id)
          );
        } else {
          drawingsItems = this.expandDrawingsVersion(version.id);
        }
        this.pushDrawingsFingerprint(fingerprint(arrayCanonical(drawingsItems)), version.id);
        prevDrawingsHead = version.id;
      }
    }
    capture(checkpoint) {
      const index = this.checkpointCount;
      this.checkpointCount += 1;
      const training = checkpoint.training ? {
        metaRef: this.intern(this.metaTable, clone(checkpoint.training.training)),
        accountRef: this.intern(this.accountTable, clone(checkpoint.training.account)),
        tradeRefs: checkpoint.training.trades.map((trade) => this.intern(this.tradeTable, clone(trade)))
      } : null;
      const chart = checkpoint.chart ? {
        timeframe: checkpoint.chart.timeframe,
        seriesRef: this.internSeries(checkpoint.chart.timeframe, clone(checkpoint.chart.bars), deriveAsOf(checkpoint), index),
        drawingsRef: this.internDrawings(clone(checkpoint.chart.drawings)),
        view: { ...checkpoint.chart.view, paneHeights: { ...checkpoint.chart.view.paneHeights } },
        costPrice: checkpoint.chart.costPrice
      } : null;
      const contextRef = checkpoint.context === null ? null : this.intern(this.contextTable, clone(checkpoint.context));
      return {
        id: checkpoint.id,
        afterSeq: checkpoint.afterSeq,
        segmentId: checkpoint.segmentId,
        capturedAt: checkpoint.capturedAt,
        ui: { ...checkpoint.ui },
        training,
        chart,
        contextRef
      };
    }
    /** 只读视图：调用方不得修改（存储任务按追加条目增量读取） */
    getResources() {
      return this.resources;
    }
    // ---- 内容去重表：指纹只是索引（只存id），命中后临时规范化比较完整内容 ----
    intern(table, value) {
      const canonical = canonicalJson(value);
      const bucket = table.byFingerprint.get(fingerprint(canonical));
      if (bucket) {
        for (const id2 of bucket) {
          const entry = table.byId.get(id2);
          if (entry && canonicalJson(entry.value) === canonical) return id2;
        }
      }
      let id = `${table.prefix}${table.nextId}`;
      while (table.ids.has(id)) {
        table.nextId += 1;
        id = `${table.prefix}${table.nextId}`;
      }
      table.nextId += 1;
      table.ids.add(id);
      table.entries.push({ id, value });
      table.byId.set(id, table.entries[table.entries.length - 1]);
      const updated = bucket ?? [];
      updated.push(id);
      table.byFingerprint.set(fingerprint(canonical), updated);
      return id;
    }
    // ---- series：同周期线性链，31层增量上限，历史同内容复用，空增量用于标注新asOf ----
    internSeries(timeframe, bars, asOf, index) {
      const headId = this.seriesHeads.get(timeframe);
      const incomingCanon = bars.map((bar) => canonicalJson(bar));
      const fullCanon = arrayCanonicalFrom(incomingCanon);
      const fp = fingerprint(fullCanon);
      if (headId === void 0) return this.appendSeriesBase(timeframe, bars, asOf, index, fp);
      const head = this.seriesIds.get(headId);
      const state = this.seriesState(timeframe, headId);
      const keys = bars.map((bar) => bar.date);
      const upsert = [];
      const upsertCanon = [];
      for (const [i, bar] of bars.entries()) {
        const at = state.index.get(bar.date);
        if (at === void 0 || canonicalJson(state.items[at]) !== incomingCanon[i]) {
          upsert.push(bar);
          upsertCanon.push(incomingCanon[i]);
        }
      }
      const keySet = new Set(keys);
      const remove = [];
      for (const key of state.index.keys()) {
        if (!keySet.has(key)) remove.push(key);
      }
      const predicted = applyDelta(state.items, upsert, remove, (bar) => bar.date);
      const orderMatches = sameKeySequence(predicted, keys, (bar) => bar.date);
      const identical = upsert.length === 0 && remove.length === 0 && orderMatches;
      if (identical) {
        if (asOf === null) return headId;
        if (head.asOf !== null && head.asOf <= asOf) return headId;
        const reused2 = this.findSeriesReuse(timeframe, fp, fullCanon, asOf, headId);
        if (reused2 !== null) return reused2;
        if (head.asOf === null && this.seriesDepth(headId) < MAX_DELTA_CHAIN) {
          return this.appendSeriesDelta(timeframe, headId, [], [], asOf, index, fp);
        }
        return this.appendSeriesBase(timeframe, bars, asOf, index, fp);
      }
      const reused = this.findSeriesReuse(timeframe, fp, fullCanon, asOf, headId);
      if (reused !== null) return reused;
      const baseAsOfBlocksDelta = asOf !== null && head.asOf !== null && head.asOf > asOf;
      const deltaBytes = upsertCanon.reduce((n, canon) => n + canon.length + 1, 0) + remove.reduce((n, key) => n + JSON.stringify(key).length + 1, 0);
      const deltaViable = orderMatches && deltaBytes < fullCanon.length && this.seriesDepth(headId) < MAX_DELTA_CHAIN && !baseAsOfBlocksDelta;
      if (deltaViable) return this.appendSeriesDelta(timeframe, headId, upsert, remove, asOf, index, fp);
      return this.appendSeriesBase(timeframe, bars, asOf, index, fp);
    }
    /** 历史同内容版本复用：指纹桶新→旧探测，asOf许可 + 临时展开规范化比对（防碰撞） */
    findSeriesReuse(timeframe, fp, fullCanon, asOf, excludeId) {
      const bucket = this.seriesFpIndex.get(timeframe)?.get(fp);
      if (!bucket) return null;
      for (let i = bucket.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
        const id = bucket[i];
        if (id === excludeId) continue;
        const version = this.seriesIds.get(id);
        if (asOf !== null && (version.asOf === null || version.asOf > asOf)) continue;
        const items = this.expandSeriesVersion(id);
        if (arrayCanonical(items) === fullCanon) return id;
      }
      return null;
    }
    expandSeriesVersion(id) {
      return expandVersionChain(
        id,
        this.seriesIds,
        "\u884C\u60C5",
        this.seriesReconstructCache,
        (version) => version.bars.slice(),
        (items, version) => applyDelta(items, version.upsert, version.remove, (bar) => bar.date)
      );
    }
    expandDrawingsVersion(id) {
      return expandVersionChain(
        id,
        this.drawingsById,
        "\u753B\u7EBF",
        this.drawingsReconstructCache,
        (version) => version.items.slice(),
        (items, version) => sortedByDrawId(applyDelta(items, version.upsert, version.remove, (drawing) => drawing.id))
      );
    }
    pushSeriesFingerprint(timeframe, fp, id) {
      let byFp = this.seriesFpIndex.get(timeframe);
      if (!byFp) {
        byFp = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
        this.seriesFpIndex.set(timeframe, byFp);
      }
      const bucket = byFp.get(fp);
      if (bucket) bucket.push(id);
      else byFp.set(fp, [id]);
    }
    pushDrawingsFingerprint(fp, id) {
      const bucket = this.drawingsFpIndex.get(fp);
      if (bucket) bucket.push(id);
      else this.drawingsFpIndex.set(fp, [id]);
    }
    seriesState(timeframe, headId) {
      const existing = this.seriesStates.get(timeframe);
      if (existing) return existing;
      const items = this.expandSeriesVersion(headId);
      const state = buildState(items, (bar) => bar.date);
      this.seriesStates.set(timeframe, state);
      return state;
    }
    appendSeriesBase(timeframe, bars, asOf, index, contentFp) {
      const id = `s${this.nextSeriesId}`;
      this.nextSeriesId += 1;
      const version = { id, timeframe, asOf, firstCheckpoint: index, base: null, bars };
      this.resources.series.push(version);
      this.seriesIds.set(id, version);
      this.seriesHeads.set(timeframe, id);
      this.seriesStates.set(timeframe, buildState(bars.slice(), (bar) => bar.date));
      this.seriesDeltaCounts.set(id, 0);
      this.pushSeriesFingerprint(timeframe, contentFp, id);
      return id;
    }
    appendSeriesDelta(timeframe, headId, upsert, remove, asOf, index, contentFp) {
      const id = `s${this.nextSeriesId}`;
      this.nextSeriesId += 1;
      const version = { id, timeframe, asOf, firstCheckpoint: index, base: headId, upsert, remove };
      this.resources.series.push(version);
      this.seriesIds.set(id, version);
      this.seriesHeads.set(timeframe, id);
      const state = this.seriesState(timeframe, headId);
      const items = applyDelta(state.items, upsert, remove, (bar) => bar.date);
      this.seriesStates.set(timeframe, buildState(items, (bar) => bar.date));
      this.seriesDeltaCounts.set(id, this.seriesDepth(headId) + 1);
      this.pushSeriesFingerprint(timeframe, contentFp, id);
      return id;
    }
    // ---- drawings：单链，按id增量；重构造按id规范序，工具/窗格/点/样式/文字原值保留 ----
    /** 恢复会话后惰性重建头部展开态：base原样、delta按id规范序 */
    ensureDrawingsState() {
      if (this.drawingsState) return this.drawingsState;
      if (this.drawingsHead === null) return null;
      this.drawingsState = buildState(this.expandDrawingsVersion(this.drawingsHead), (drawing) => drawing.id);
      return this.drawingsState;
    }
    internDrawings(items) {
      const incomingCanon = items.map((drawing) => canonicalJson(drawing));
      const fullCanon = arrayCanonicalFrom(incomingCanon);
      const fp = fingerprint(fullCanon);
      const state = this.ensureDrawingsState();
      if (!state || this.drawingsHead === null) return this.appendDrawingsBase(items, fp);
      const keys = items.map((drawing) => drawing.id);
      const upsert = [];
      const upsertCanon = [];
      for (const [i, drawing] of items.entries()) {
        const at = state.index.get(drawing.id);
        if (at === void 0 || canonicalJson(state.items[at]) !== incomingCanon[i]) {
          upsert.push(drawing);
          upsertCanon.push(incomingCanon[i]);
        }
      }
      const keySet = new Set(keys);
      const remove = [];
      for (const key of state.index.keys()) {
        if (!keySet.has(key)) remove.push(key);
      }
      const predicted = sortedByDrawId(applyDelta(state.items, upsert, remove, (drawing) => drawing.id));
      const orderMatches = sameKeySequence(predicted, keys, (drawing) => drawing.id);
      const identical = upsert.length === 0 && remove.length === 0 && orderMatches;
      if (identical) return this.drawingsHead;
      const reused = this.findDrawingsReuse(fp, fullCanon);
      if (reused !== null) return reused;
      const deltaBytes = upsertCanon.reduce((n, canon) => n + canon.length + 1, 0) + remove.reduce((n, key) => n + JSON.stringify(key).length + 1, 0);
      const deltaViable = orderMatches && deltaBytes < fullCanon.length && this.drawingsDeltaCount < MAX_DELTA_CHAIN;
      const id = `dw${this.nextDrawingId}`;
      this.nextDrawingId += 1;
      const version = deltaViable ? { id, base: this.drawingsHead, upsert, remove } : { id, base: null, items };
      this.resources.drawings.push(version);
      this.drawingsById.set(id, version);
      this.drawingsHead = id;
      this.pushDrawingsFingerprint(fp, id);
      this.drawingsState = buildState(deltaViable ? predicted : items.slice(), (drawing) => drawing.id);
      this.drawingsDeltaCount = deltaViable ? this.drawingsDeltaCount + 1 : 0;
      return id;
    }
    findDrawingsReuse(fp, fullCanon) {
      const bucket = this.drawingsFpIndex.get(fp);
      if (!bucket) return null;
      for (let i = bucket.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
        const id = bucket[i];
        if (id === this.drawingsHead) continue;
        const items = this.expandDrawingsVersion(id);
        if (arrayCanonical(items) === fullCanon) return id;
      }
      return null;
    }
    appendDrawingsBase(items, contentFp) {
      const id = `dw${this.nextDrawingId}`;
      this.nextDrawingId += 1;
      const version = { id, base: null, items };
      this.resources.drawings.push(version);
      this.drawingsById.set(id, version);
      this.drawingsHead = id;
      this.drawingsState = buildState(items.slice(), (drawing) => drawing.id);
      this.drawingsDeltaCount = 0;
      this.pushDrawingsFingerprint(contentFp, id);
      return id;
    }
  };
  function arrayCanonical(items) {
    return `[${items.map((item) => canonicalJson(item)).join(",")}]`;
  }
  function arrayCanonicalFrom(canonicalItems) {
    return `[${canonicalItems.join(",")}]`;
  }
  function compactRecording(file) {
    const builder = new CompactBuilder();
    const checkpoints = file.checkpoints.map((checkpoint) => builder.capture(checkpoint));
    return {
      format: file.format,
      schemaVersion: 2,
      sessionId: file.sessionId,
      createdAt: file.createdAt,
      app: { ...file.app },
      environment: { ...file.environment, viewport: { ...file.environment.viewport } },
      trainingKey: file.trainingKey,
      events: [...file.events],
      checkpoints,
      gaps: file.gaps.map((gap) => ({ ...gap })),
      complete: file.complete,
      resources: builder.getResources()
    };
  }
  var LruCache = class {
    constructor(limit) {
      this.limit = limit;
    }
    limit;
    map = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    get(key) {
      const value = this.map.get(key);
      if (value !== void 0) {
        this.map.delete(key);
        this.map.set(key, value);
      }
      return value;
    }
    set(key, value) {
      this.map.delete(key);
      this.map.set(key, value);
      while (this.map.size > this.limit) {
        const oldest = this.map.keys().next();
        if (oldest.done) break;
        this.map.delete(oldest.value);
      }
    }
  };

  var MAX_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
  var MAX_EVENTS = 5e4;
  var MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 2e3;
  var MAX_DEPTH = 40;
  var MAX_DRAWINGS = 500;
  var MAX_DRAWING_POINTS = 256;
  var ACTION_SET = new Set(ACTIONS);
  var DRAWING_NAMES = new Set(DRAW_TOOLS.map((tool) => tool.name));
  var DRAWING_PANES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["candle_pane", "VOL", "MACD", "KDJ"]);
  var PHASES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["started", "finished"]);
  var SOURCES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["ui", "keyboard", "chart", "system"]);
  var OUTCOMES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["accepted", "rejected", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted", "unknown"]);
  var TIMEFRAMES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["1D", "1W", "1M"]);

  var TRAINING_STATUS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["running", "settled", "abandoned"]);
  var ADJUST_MODES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["forward", "raw"]);
  var TRADE_SIDES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["buy", "sell"]);
  var RANGE_MODES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["preset", "latest", "bars", "random"]);
  var DATE_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
  var MONTH_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/;
  var OHLC_KEYS = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "amount"];
  var ACCOUNT_KEYS = ["cash", "shares", "availableShares", "marketValue", "equity"];
  function fail(field, reason) {
    throw new Error(`\u5F55\u5236\u6587\u4EF6\u6821\u9A8C\u5931\u8D25\uFF1A${field ? `${field} ` : ""}${reason}`);
  }
  function isRecord(value) {
    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
    const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
    return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
  }
  function joinField(field, key) {
    return field ? `${field}.${key}` : key;
  }
  function assertJson(value, field, depth) {
    if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) fail(field, `\u5D4C\u5957\u6DF1\u5EA6\u8D85\u8FC7 ${MAX_DEPTH} \u5C42`);
    switch (typeof value) {
      case "string":
      case "boolean":
        return;
      case "number":
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
          fail(field, "\u6570\u503C\u5FC5\u987B\u6709\u9650\uFF08NaN/Infinity \u65E0\u6CD5\u88AB JSON \u5B89\u5168\u5E8F\u5217\u5316\uFF0CJSON.stringify \u4F1A\u9759\u9ED8\u5199\u6210 null\uFF09");
        }
        return;
      case "object":
        if (value === null) return;
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          value.forEach((item, index) => assertJson(item, `${field}[${index}]`, depth + 1));
          return;
        }
        if (isRecord(value)) {
          for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) assertJson(item, joinField(field, key), depth + 1);
          return;
        }
        fail(field, `\u4EC5\u652F\u6301\u7EAF JSON \u5BF9\u8C61/\u6570\u7EC4\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${value.constructor?.name ?? "\u672A\u77E5\u5BF9\u8C61"}\uFF09`);
        return;
      case "undefined":
        fail(field, "\u542B undefined\uFF0C\u65E0\u6CD5\u88AB JSON \u5B89\u5168\u5E8F\u5217\u5316\uFF08JSON.stringify \u4F1A\u9759\u9ED8\u4E22\u5F03\u8BE5\u503C\uFF09");
        return;
      default:
        fail(field, `\u7C7B\u578B ${typeof value} \u4E0D\u80FD\u88AB JSON \u5E8F\u5217\u5316`);
    }
  }
  function assertRecord(value, field) {
    if (!isRecord(value)) fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F JSON \u5BF9\u8C61");
    return value;
  }
  function assertArray(value, field) {
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u6570\u7EC4");
    return value;
  }
  function assertString(value, field) {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u975E\u7A7A\u5B57\u7B26\u4E32");
    return value;
  }
  function assertStringOrNull(value, field) {
    if (value === null) return null;
    return assertString(value, field);
  }
  function assertBoolean(value, field) {
    if (typeof value !== "boolean") fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u5E03\u5C14\u503C");
    return value;
  }
  function assertFinite(value, field) {
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u6709\u9650\u6570\u503C");
    return value;
  }
  function assertNumberOrNull(value, field) {
    if (value === null) return null;
    return assertFinite(value, field);
  }
  function assertInteger(value, field) {
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value)) fail(field, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u6574\u6570");
    return value;
  }
  function assertPositive(value, field) {
    const number = assertFinite(value, field);
    if (number <= 0) fail(field, `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u6B63\u6570\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${number}\uFF09`);
    return number;
  }
  function assertEnum(value, field, allowed) {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || !allowed.has(value)) {
      fail(field, `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F ${[...allowed].join("/")} \u4E4B\u4E00\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(value)}\uFF09`);
    }
    return value;
  }
  function assertDate(value, field) {
    const text = assertString(value, field);
    if (!DATE_PATTERN.test(text)) fail(field, `\u65E5\u671F\u987B\u4E3A YYYY-MM-DD \u683C\u5F0F\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(text)}\uFF09`);
    const [year, month, day] = text.split("-").map(Number);
    const utc = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
    if (utc.getUTCFullYear() !== year || utc.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 || utc.getUTCDate() !== day) {
      fail(field, `\u4E0D\u662F\u6709\u6548\u7684\u65E5\u5386\u65E5\u671F\uFF08${text}\uFF09`);
    }
    return text;
  }
  function assertDateOrNull(value, field) {
    if (value === null) return null;
    return assertDate(value, field);
  }
  function assertBarDate(value, field, timeframe) {
    if (typeof value === "string" && timeframe === "1M" && MONTH_PATTERN.test(value)) {
      const month = Number(value.slice(5, 7));
      if (month >= 1 && month <= 12) return `${value}-01`;
      fail(field, `\u4E0D\u662F\u6709\u6548\u7684\u6708\u4EFD\uFF08${value}\uFF09`);
    }
    return assertDate(value, field);
  }
  function assertTimestamp(value, field) {
    const text = assertString(value, field);
    if (Number.isNaN(Date.parse(text))) fail(field, `\u65F6\u95F4\u987B\u4E3A\u53EF\u89E3\u6790\u7684\u65E5\u671F\u65F6\u95F4\u5B57\u7B26\u4E32\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(text)}\uFF09`);
    return text;
  }
  function assertEvent(raw, field, index) {
    const event = assertRecord(raw, field);
    assertInteger(event.seq, `${field}.seq`);
    if (event.seq !== index + 1) {
      fail(`${field}.seq`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u4ECE 1 \u8FDE\u7EED\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u4F4D\u7F6E ${index} \u671F\u671B ${index + 1}\uFF0C\u5B9E\u9645 ${JSON.stringify(event.seq)}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertString(event.opId, `${field}.opId`);
    const segmentId = assertString(event.segmentId, `${field}.segmentId`);
    const elapsedMs = assertFinite(event.elapsedMs, `${field}.elapsedMs`);
    if (elapsedMs < 0) fail(`${field}.elapsedMs`, "\u4E0D\u80FD\u4E3A\u8D1F\u6570");
    const phase = assertEnum(event.phase, `${field}.phase`, PHASES);
    if (typeof event.action !== "string" || !ACTION_SET.has(event.action)) {
      fail(`${field}.action`, `\u4E0D\u5728\u52A8\u4F5C\u767D\u540D\u5355\u5185\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(event.action)}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertEnum(event.source, `${field}.source`, SOURCES);
    if (phase === "started") {
      if (event.outcome !== void 0) fail(`${field}.outcome`, "started \u4E8B\u4EF6\u4E0D\u5F97\u643A\u5E26 outcome");
    } else if (event.outcome === void 0) {
      fail(`${field}.outcome`, "finished \u4E8B\u4EF6\u5FC5\u987B\u643A\u5E26 outcome");
    } else {
      assertEnum(event.outcome, `${field}.outcome`, OUTCOMES);
    }
    const checkpointId = event.checkpointId === void 0 ? void 0 : assertString(event.checkpointId, `${field}.checkpointId`);
    return { segmentId, checkpointId, elapsedMs };
  }
  function assertEventPairing(events, complete) {
    const started = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const finished = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    events.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const event = raw;
      const field = `events[${index}].opId`;
      if (event.phase === "started") {
        if (started.has(event.opId)) fail(field, `started \u91CD\u590D\uFF08opId ${event.opId}\uFF09`);
        started.set(event.opId, { action: event.action, source: event.source, segmentId: event.segmentId });
        return;
      }
      const opened = started.get(event.opId);
      if (!opened) fail(field, `finished \u7F3A\u5C11\u914D\u5BF9\u7684 started\uFF08opId ${event.opId}\uFF09`);
      if (finished.has(event.opId)) fail(field, `finished \u91CD\u590D\uFF08opId ${event.opId}\uFF09`);
      if (opened && (opened.action !== event.action || opened.source !== event.source || opened.segmentId !== event.segmentId)) {
        fail(field, `finished \u4E0E started \u7684 action/source/segmentId \u5FC5\u987B\u4E00\u81F4\uFF08opId ${event.opId}\uFF09`);
      }
      finished.add(event.opId);
    });
    const dangling = [...started.keys()].filter((opId) => !finished.has(opId));
    if (dangling.length > 0 && complete) {
      fail("complete", `\u5B58\u5728\u672A\u95ED\u5408\u7684 started \u64CD\u4F5C\uFF08opId ${dangling.join("\u3001")}\uFF09\uFF0C\u4E2D\u65AD\u5C3E\u6BB5\u672A\u95ED\u5408\u65F6 complete \u4E0D\u80FD\u4E3A true`);
    }
  }
  function assertBar(raw, field, timeframe) {
    const bar = assertRecord(raw, field);
    const date = assertBarDate(bar.date, `${field}.date`, timeframe);
    for (const key of OHLC_KEYS) assertFinite(bar[key], `${field}.${key}`);
    return date;
  }
  function assertDrawing(raw, field, drawingIds) {
    const drawing = assertRecord(raw, field);
    const id = assertString(drawing.id, `${field}.id`);
    if (drawingIds.has(id)) fail(`${field}.id`, `\u753B\u7EBF id \u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
    drawingIds.add(id);
    const name = assertString(drawing.name, `${field}.name`);
    if (!DRAWING_NAMES.has(name)) {
      fail(`${field}.name`, `\u4E0D\u5728 drawTools \u6CE8\u518C\u96C6\u5408\u5185\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${name}\uFF0C\u5F15\u64CE\u5185\u7F6E bsMark/costLine \u4E0D\u5F97\u8FDB\u5165\u5F55\u5236\uFF09`);
    }
    const paneId = assertString(drawing.paneId, `${field}.paneId`);
    if (!DRAWING_PANES.has(paneId)) {
      fail(`${field}.paneId`, `\u4EC5\u5141\u8BB8 candle_pane/VOL/MACD/KDJ\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${paneId}\uFF09`);
    }
    const points = assertArray(drawing.points, `${field}.points`);
    if (points.length > MAX_DRAWING_POINTS) {
      fail(`${field}.points`, `\u5355\u6761\u753B\u7EBF\u70B9\u6570 ${points.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DRAWING_POINTS}`);
    }
    points.forEach((point, index) => {
      const item = assertRecord(point, `${field}.points[${index}]`);
      assertFinite(item.timestamp, `${field}.points[${index}].timestamp`);
      assertFinite(item.value, `${field}.points[${index}].value`);
    });
    if (drawing.styles !== void 0 && !isRecord(drawing.styles)) {
      fail(`${field}.styles`, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F JSON \u5BF9\u8C61");
    }
  }
  function assertChartView(view, field) {
    const record = assertRecord(view, field);
    assertNumberOrNull(record.fromTimestamp, `${field}.fromTimestamp`);
    assertNumberOrNull(record.toTimestamp, `${field}.toTimestamp`);
    assertPositive(record.barSpace, `${field}.barSpace`);
    const paneHeights = assertRecord(record.paneHeights, `${field}.paneHeights`);
    for (const [key, height] of Object.entries(paneHeights)) {
      assertPositive(height, `${field}.paneHeights.${key}`);
    }
  }
  function assertChartCapture(raw, field) {
    const chart = assertRecord(raw, field);
    const timeframe = assertEnum(chart.timeframe, `${field}.timeframe`, TIMEFRAMES);
    const barDates = assertArray(chart.bars, `${field}.bars`).map(
      (bar, index) => assertBar(bar, `${field}.bars[${index}]`, timeframe)
    );
    barDates.forEach((date, index) => {
      if (index > 0 && date <= barDates[index - 1]) {
        fail(`${field}.bars[${index}].date`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u4E25\u683C\u6309\u65E5\u671F\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${barDates[index - 1]}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${date}\uFF09`);
      }
    });
    const drawings = assertArray(chart.drawings, `${field}.drawings`);
    if (drawings.length > MAX_DRAWINGS) {
      fail(`${field}.drawings`, `\u753B\u7EBF\u6570\u91CF ${drawings.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DRAWINGS}`);
    }
    const drawingIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    drawings.forEach((drawing, index) => {
      assertDrawing(drawing, `${field}.drawings[${index}]`, drawingIds);
    });
    assertChartView(chart.view, `${field}.view`);
    assertNumberOrNull(chart.costPrice, `${field}.costPrice`);
    return barDates;
  }
  function assertTrade(raw, field) {
    const trade = assertRecord(raw, field);
    assertInteger(trade.seq, `${field}.seq`);
    assertDate(trade.date, `${field}.date`);
    assertEnum(trade.side, `${field}.side`, TRADE_SIDES);
    assertFinite(trade.price, `${field}.price`);
    assertFinite(trade.shares, `${field}.shares`);
    assertFinite(trade.amount, `${field}.amount`);
    assertFinite(trade.fee, `${field}.fee`);
    if (trade.chartPrice !== void 0) assertFinite(trade.chartPrice, `${field}.chartPrice`);
    if (trade.blindIndex !== void 0) assertInteger(trade.blindIndex, `${field}.blindIndex`);
    if (trade.blindLabel !== void 0) assertString(trade.blindLabel, `${field}.blindLabel`);
  }
  function assertTrainingRangeMeta(raw, field, training) {
    const range = assertRecord(raw, field);
    if (range.version !== 1) fail(`${field}.version`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F 1\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(range.version)}\uFF09`);
    assertEnum(range.mode, `${field}.mode`, RANGE_MODES);
    assertDate(range.requestedStart, `${field}.requestedStart`);
    assertDateOrNull(range.requestedEnd, `${field}.requestedEnd`);
    assertDate(range.startDate, `${field}.startDate`);
    assertDate(range.endDate, `${field}.endDate`);
    if (typeof range.barCount !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(range.barCount) || range.barCount <= 0) {
      fail(`${field}.barCount`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u6B63\u5B89\u5168\u6574\u6570\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(range.barCount)}\uFF09`);
    }
    if (typeof range.sourceFingerprint !== "string" || !range.sourceFingerprint) {
      fail(`${field}.sourceFingerprint`, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u975E\u7A7A\u5B57\u7B26\u4E32");
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(range.notes) || !range.notes.every((note) => typeof note === "string")) {
      fail(`${field}.notes`, "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F\u5B57\u7B26\u4E32\u6570\u7EC4");
    }
    if (range.startDate !== training.startDate) {
      fail(`${field}.startDate`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u4E0E\u8BAD\u7EC3 startDate\uFF08${JSON.stringify(training.startDate)}\uFF09\u4E00\u81F4`);
    }
    if (range.endDate !== training.plannedEnd) {
      fail(`${field}.endDate`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u4E0E\u8BAD\u7EC3 plannedEnd\uFF08${JSON.stringify(training.plannedEnd)}\uFF09\u4E00\u81F4`);
    }
  }
  function assertTrainingMeta(raw, field, options) {
    const meta = assertRecord(raw, field);
    assertInteger(meta.id, `${field}.id`);
    if (options?.allowRange && meta.tier === "RANGE") {
      if (!isRecord(meta.range)) fail(`${field}.range`, "RANGE \u8BAD\u7EC3\u5FC5\u987B\u643A\u5E26\u5408\u89C4\u7684\u8303\u56F4\u5143\u6570\u636E\u5BF9\u8C61");
      assertTrainingRangeMeta(meta.range, `${field}.range`, meta);
    } else {
      assertEnum(meta.tier, `${field}.tier`, TIERS);
      if ("range" in meta) {
        fail(`${field}.range`, "\u65E7\u4E94\u6863 tier \u4E0D\u5F97\u643A\u5E26\u8303\u56F4\u5143\u6570\u636E");
      }
    }
    assertStringOrNull(meta.code, `${field}.code`);
    assertStringOrNull(meta.name, `${field}.name`);
    assertString(meta.market, `${field}.market`);
    assertDate(meta.startDate, `${field}.startDate`);
    assertDate(meta.plannedEnd, `${field}.plannedEnd`);
    assertDateOrNull(meta.currentDate, `${field}.currentDate`);
    assertEnum(meta.status, `${field}.status`, TRAINING_STATUS);
    assertDateOrNull(meta.settleDate, `${field}.settleDate`);
    assertBoolean(meta.earlySettle, `${field}.earlySettle`);
    assertBoolean(meta.blind, `${field}.blind`);
    assertEnum(meta.adjustMode, `${field}.adjustMode`, ADJUST_MODES);
    assertFinite(meta.initialCash, `${field}.initialCash`);
    assertTimestamp(meta.createdAt, `${field}.createdAt`);
  }
  function assertAccountView(raw, field) {
    const account = assertRecord(raw, field);
    for (const key of ACCOUNT_KEYS) assertFinite(account[key], `${field}.${key}`);
    assertNumberOrNull(account.costPrice, `${field}.costPrice`);
  }
  function assertTrainingSnapshot(raw, field) {
    const snapshot = assertRecord(raw, field);
    assertTrainingMeta(snapshot.training, `${field}.training`);
    assertAccountView(snapshot.account, `${field}.account`);
    assertArray(snapshot.trades, `${field}.trades`).forEach((trade, index) => {
      assertTrade(trade, `${field}.trades[${index}]`);
    });
  }
  function assertCheckpoint(raw, field, eventCount, segmentIds, checkpointIds) {
    const checkpoint = assertRecord(raw, field);
    const id = assertString(checkpoint.id, `${field}.id`);
    if (checkpointIds.has(id)) fail(`${field}.id`, `\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9 id \u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
    const afterSeq = assertInteger(checkpoint.afterSeq, `${field}.afterSeq`);
    if (afterSeq < 0 || afterSeq > eventCount) {
      fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u987B\u5728 0..${eventCount} \u8303\u56F4\u5185\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
    }
    checkpointIds.set(id, afterSeq);
    const segmentId = assertString(checkpoint.segmentId, `${field}.segmentId`);
    if (afterSeq > 0 && !segmentIds.has(segmentId)) {
      fail(`${field}.segmentId`, `\u672A\u51FA\u73B0\u5728\u4EFB\u4F55\u4E8B\u4EF6\u4E2D\uFF08${segmentId}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertTimestamp(checkpoint.capturedAt, `${field}.capturedAt`);
    const training = checkpoint.training === null ? null : (assertTrainingSnapshot(checkpoint.training, `${field}.training`), checkpoint.training);
    let chart = null;
    let barDates = [];
    if (checkpoint.chart !== null) {
      barDates = assertChartCapture(checkpoint.chart, `${field}.chart`);
      chart = checkpoint.chart;
    }
    const ui = assertRecord(checkpoint.ui, `${field}.ui`);
    assertString(ui.theme, `${field}.ui.theme`);
    assertStringOrNull(ui.tool, `${field}.ui.tool`);
    assertString(ui.magnet, `${field}.ui.magnet`);
    assertBoolean(ui.multiSelect, `${field}.ui.multiSelect`);
    return { afterSeq, training, chart, barDates };
  }
  function validateRecording(value, options) {
    const maxCheckpoints = options?.maxCheckpoints ?? MAX_CHECKPOINTS;
    if (!isRecord(value)) fail("\u9876\u5C42", "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F JSON \u5BF9\u8C61");
    assertJson(value, "", 1);
    if (value.format !== "trainer-session") {
      fail("format", `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F 'trainer-session'\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(value.format)}\uFF09`);
    }
    if (value.schemaVersion !== 1) {
      fail("schemaVersion", `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F 1\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(value.schemaVersion)}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertString(value.sessionId, "sessionId");
    assertTimestamp(value.createdAt, "createdAt");
    const app = assertRecord(value.app, "app");
    assertString(app.version, "app.version");
    assertString(app.gitCommit, "app.gitCommit");
    assertBoolean(app.dirty, "app.dirty");
    assertString(app.chartLibrary, "app.chartLibrary");
    const environment = assertRecord(value.environment, "environment");
    assertString(environment.timezone, "environment.timezone");
    const viewport = assertRecord(environment.viewport, "environment.viewport");
    assertPositive(viewport.width, "environment.viewport.width");
    assertPositive(viewport.height, "environment.viewport.height");
    assertPositive(environment.dpr, "environment.dpr");
    assertStringOrNull(value.trainingKey, "trainingKey");
    assertBoolean(value.complete, "complete");
    const events = assertArray(value.events, "events");
    if (events.length > MAX_EVENTS) fail("events", `\u4E8B\u4EF6\u6570\u91CF ${events.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_EVENTS}`);
    const checkpoints = assertArray(value.checkpoints, "checkpoints");
    if (checkpoints.length > maxCheckpoints) {
      fail("checkpoints", `\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u6570\u91CF ${checkpoints.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${maxCheckpoints}`);
    }
    const gaps = assertArray(value.gaps, "gaps");
    const segmentIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    const checkpointRefs = [];
    let lastElapsedMs = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    events.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const checked = assertEvent(raw, `events[${index}]`, index);
      if (checked.elapsedMs < lastElapsedMs) {
        fail(`events[${index}].elapsedMs`, `\u987B\u5168\u5C40\u5355\u8C03\u4E0D\u51CF\uFF08\u524D\u4E00\u4E8B\u4EF6 ${lastElapsedMs}\uFF0C\u672C\u4E8B\u4EF6 ${checked.elapsedMs}\uFF09`);
      }
      lastElapsedMs = checked.elapsedMs;
      segmentIds.add(checked.segmentId);
      checkpointRefs.push({ checkpointId: checked.checkpointId, seq: index + 1 });
    });
    assertEventPairing(events, value.complete);
    const checkpointIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const checkedCheckpoints = [];
    let previousCheckpointAfterSeq = 0;
    checkpoints.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const checked = assertCheckpoint(raw, `checkpoints[${index}]`, events.length, segmentIds, checkpointIds);
      if (checked.afterSeq < previousCheckpointAfterSeq) {
        fail(`checkpoints[${index}].afterSeq`, `\u987B\u6309 afterSeq \u975E\u9012\u51CF\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${previousCheckpointAfterSeq}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${checked.afterSeq}\uFF09\uFF0C\u540C seq \u5141\u8BB8\u591A\u4E2A\u66F4\u5B8C\u6574\u72B6\u6001`);
      }
      previousCheckpointAfterSeq = checked.afterSeq;
      checkedCheckpoints.push(checked);
    });
    checkpointRefs.forEach(({ checkpointId, seq }, index) => {
      if (checkpointId === void 0) return;
      const afterSeq = checkpointIds.get(checkpointId);
      if (afterSeq === void 0) {
        fail(`events[${index}].checkpointId`, `\u5F15\u7528\u4E86\u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\u7684\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9 id\uFF08${checkpointId}\uFF09`);
      }
      if (afterSeq > seq) {
        fail(`events[${index}].checkpointId`, `\u6307\u5411\u672A\u6765\u5FEB\u7167\uFF08\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9 afterSeq=${afterSeq} \u665A\u4E8E\u4E8B\u4EF6 seq=${seq}\uFF09`);
      }
    });
    checkedCheckpoints.forEach((checked, index) => {
      const cutoff = checked.training === null ? null : checked.training.training.currentDate ?? checked.training.training.startDate;
      if (cutoff === null || checked.chart === null) return;
      checked.barDates.forEach((date, barIndex) => {
        if (date > cutoff) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].chart.bars[${barIndex}].date`, `\u665A\u4E8E\u884C\u60C5\u622A\u6B62\uFF08\u622A\u6B62 ${cutoff}\uFF0CcurrentDate \u4E3A null \u65F6\u6309 startDate \u6BD4\u8F83\uFF09\uFF0C\u4E0D\u5F97\u5305\u542B\u672A\u6765\u6570\u636E`);
        }
      });
    });
    let previousGapAfterSeq = -1;
    let hasOpenGap = false;
    gaps.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const gap = assertRecord(raw, `gaps[${index}]`);
      const field = `gaps[${index}]`;
      const afterSeq = assertInteger(gap.afterSeq, `${field}.afterSeq`);
      if (afterSeq < 0 || afterSeq > events.length) {
        fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u987B\u5728 0..${events.length} \u8303\u56F4\u5185\uFF080 \u8868\u793A\u81EA\u5F00\u59CB\u672A\u5F55\u5236\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
      }
      if (afterSeq <= previousGapAfterSeq) {
        fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `gaps \u987B\u6309 afterSeq \u4E25\u683C\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${previousGapAfterSeq}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09\uFF0CafterSeq=0 \u4EC5\u5141\u8BB8\u7528\u4E8E\u9996\u4E2A gap`);
      }
      if (hasOpenGap) fail(field, "\u672A\u95ED\u5408 gap\uFF08resumedAtSeq=null\uFF09\u5FC5\u987B\u4F4D\u4E8E\u672B\u5C3E\uFF0C\u5176\u540E\u4E0D\u5F97\u518D\u6709 gap");
      if (gap.resumedAtSeq === null) {
        hasOpenGap = true;
      } else {
        const resumedAtSeq = assertInteger(gap.resumedAtSeq, `${field}.resumedAtSeq`);
        if (resumedAtSeq <= afterSeq) fail(`${field}.resumedAtSeq`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u5927\u4E8E afterSeq\uFF08${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
        if (resumedAtSeq > events.length) {
          fail(`${field}.resumedAtSeq`, `\u8D85\u51FA\u4E8B\u4EF6\u8303\u56F4\uFF08\u6700\u5927 ${events.length}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${resumedAtSeq}\uFF09`);
        }
        const previous = gaps[index - 1];
        if (index > 0 && typeof previous?.resumedAtSeq === "number" && previous.resumedAtSeq > afterSeq) {
          fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u4E0E\u524D\u4E00\u4E2A gap \u91CD\u53E0\uFF08\u524D\u4E00 gap \u6062\u590D\u4E8E seq ${previous.resumedAtSeq}\uFF0C\u672C gap \u5F00\u59CB\u4E8E seq ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
        }
      }
      previousGapAfterSeq = afterSeq;
    });
    if (hasOpenGap && value.complete) {
      fail("complete", "\u5B58\u5728\u672A\u95ED\u5408\u7684 gap\uFF08resumedAtSeq=null\uFF0C\u5F55\u5236\u81EA\u8BE5\u5904\u505C\u6B62\uFF09\uFF0Ccomplete \u4E0D\u80FD\u4E3A true");
    }
    return value;
  }

  function deriveCutoff(meta) {
    if (meta.currentDate !== null) return meta.currentDate;
    return meta.blind ? null : meta.startDate;
  }

    const refs = [];

      if (checked.elapsedMs < lastElapsedMs) {
        fail(`events[${index}].elapsedMs`, `\u987B\u5168\u5C40\u5355\u8C03\u4E0D\u51CF\uFF08\u524D\u4E00\u4E8B\u4EF6 ${lastElapsedMs}\uFF0C\u672C\u4E8B\u4EF6 ${checked.elapsedMs}\uFF09`);
      }

    });

  }
  function assertCompactCheckpoint(raw, field, eventCount, segmentIds, checkpointIds) {
    const checkpoint = assertRecord(raw, field);
    const id = assertString(checkpoint.id, `${field}.id`);
    if (checkpointIds.has(id)) fail(`${field}.id`, `\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9 id \u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
    const afterSeq = assertInteger(checkpoint.afterSeq, `${field}.afterSeq`);
    if (afterSeq < 0 || afterSeq > eventCount) {
      fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u987B\u5728 0..${eventCount} \u8303\u56F4\u5185\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
    }
    checkpointIds.set(id, afterSeq);
    const segmentId = assertString(checkpoint.segmentId, `${field}.segmentId`);
    if (afterSeq > 0 && !segmentIds.has(segmentId)) {
      fail(`${field}.segmentId`, `\u672A\u51FA\u73B0\u5728\u4EFB\u4F55\u4E8B\u4EF6\u4E2D\uFF08${segmentId}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertTimestamp(checkpoint.capturedAt, `${field}.capturedAt`);
    const ui = assertRecord(checkpoint.ui, `${field}.ui`);
    assertString(ui.theme, `${field}.ui.theme`);
    assertStringOrNull(ui.tool, `${field}.ui.tool`);
    assertString(ui.magnet, `${field}.ui.magnet`);
    assertBoolean(ui.multiSelect, `${field}.ui.multiSelect`);
    if (checkpoint.training !== null) {
      const training = assertRecord(checkpoint.training, `${field}.training`);
      assertString(training.metaRef, `${field}.training.metaRef`);
      assertString(training.accountRef, `${field}.training.accountRef`);
      const tradeRefs = assertArray(training.tradeRefs, `${field}.training.tradeRefs`);
      tradeRefs.forEach((ref, index) => assertString(ref, `${field}.training.tradeRefs[${index}]`));
    }
    if (checkpoint.chart !== null) {
      const chart = assertRecord(checkpoint.chart, `${field}.chart`);
      assertEnum(chart.timeframe, `${field}.chart.timeframe`, TIMEFRAMES);
      assertString(chart.seriesRef, `${field}.chart.seriesRef`);
      assertString(chart.drawingsRef, `${field}.chart.drawingsRef`);
      assertChartView(chart.view, `${field}.chart.view`);
      assertNumberOrNull(chart.costPrice, `${field}.chart.costPrice`);
    }
    if (checkpoint.contextRef !== null) assertString(checkpoint.contextRef, `${field}.contextRef`);
    return afterSeq;
  }
  function assertCompactCheckpoints(value, eventCount, segmentIds) {
    const checkpoints = assertArray(value.checkpoints, "checkpoints");
    if (checkpoints.length > MAX_CHECKPOINTS2) {
      fail("checkpoints", `\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u6570\u91CF ${checkpoints.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_CHECKPOINTS2}`);
    }
    const checkpointIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    let previousAfterSeq = 0;
    checkpoints.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const field = `checkpoints[${index}]`;
      const afterSeq = assertCompactCheckpoint(raw, field, eventCount, segmentIds, checkpointIds);
      if (afterSeq < previousAfterSeq) {
        fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u987B\u6309 afterSeq \u975E\u9012\u51CF\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${previousAfterSeq}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09\uFF0C\u540C seq \u5141\u8BB8\u591A\u4E2A\u66F4\u5B8C\u6574\u72B6\u6001`);
      }
      previousAfterSeq = afterSeq;
    });
    return checkpointIds;
  }
  function assertEventCheckpointRefs(refs, checkpointIds) {
