      }
      if (afterSeq !== void 0 && afterSeq > index + 1) {
        fail(`events[${index}].checkpointId`, `\u6307\u5411\u672A\u6765\u5FEB\u7167\uFF08\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9 afterSeq=${afterSeq} \u665A\u4E8E\u4E8B\u4EF6 seq=${index + 1}\uFF09`);
      }
    });
  }
  function assertGaps(value, eventCount) {
    const gaps = assertArray(value.gaps, "gaps");
    let previousGapAfterSeq = -1;
    let hasOpenGap = false;
    gaps.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const gap = assertRecord(raw, `gaps[${index}]`);
      const field = `gaps[${index}]`;
      const afterSeq = assertInteger(gap.afterSeq, `${field}.afterSeq`);
      if (afterSeq < 0 || afterSeq > eventCount) {
        fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u987B\u5728 0..${eventCount} \u8303\u56F4\u5185\uFF080 \u8868\u793A\u81EA\u5F00\u59CB\u672A\u5F55\u5236\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
      }
      if (afterSeq <= previousGapAfterSeq) {
        fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `gaps \u987B\u6309 afterSeq \u4E25\u683C\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${previousGapAfterSeq}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${afterSeq}\uFF09\uFF0CafterSeq=0 \u4EC5\u5141\u8BB8\u7528\u4E8E\u9996\u4E2A gap`);
      }
      if (hasOpenGap) fail(field, "\u672A\u95ED\u5408 gap\uFF08resumedAtSeq=null\uFF09\u5FC5\u987B\u4F4D\u4E8E\u672B\u5C3E\uFF0C\u5176\u540E\u4E0D\u5F97\u518D\u6709 gap");
      if (gap.resumedAtSeq === null) {
        hasOpenGap = true;
      } else {
        const resumedAtSeq = assertInteger(gap.resumedAtSeq, `${field}.resumedAtSeq`);
        if (resumedAtSeq <= afterSeq) fail(`${field}.resumedAtSeq`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u5927\u4E8E afterSeq\uFF08${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
        if (resumedAtSeq > eventCount) {
          fail(`${field}.resumedAtSeq`, `\u8D85\u51FA\u4E8B\u4EF6\u8303\u56F4\uFF08\u6700\u5927 ${eventCount}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${resumedAtSeq}\uFF09`);
        }
        const previous = gaps[index - 1];
        if (index > 0 && typeof previous?.resumedAtSeq === "number" && previous.resumedAtSeq > afterSeq) {
          fail(`${field}.afterSeq`, `\u4E0E\u524D\u4E00\u4E2A gap \u91CD\u53E0\uFF08\u524D\u4E00 gap \u6062\u590D\u4E8E seq ${previous.resumedAtSeq}\uFF0C\u672C gap \u5F00\u59CB\u4E8E seq ${afterSeq}\uFF09`);
        }
      }
      previousGapAfterSeq = afterSeq;
    });
    if (hasOpenGap && value.complete) {
      fail("complete", "\u5B58\u5728\u672A\u95ED\u5408\u7684 gap\uFF08resumedAtSeq=null\uFF0C\u5F55\u5236\u81EA\u8BE5\u5904\u505C\u6B62\uFF09\uFF0Ccomplete \u4E0D\u80FD\u4E3A true");
    }
  }
  function assertValueTable(raw, field, validateValue) {
    const entries = assertArray(raw, field);
    const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    entries.forEach((entryRaw, index) => {
      const entryField = `${field}[${index}]`;
      const entry = assertRecord(entryRaw, entryField);
      const id = assertString(entry.id, `${entryField}.id`);
      if (ids.has(id)) fail(`${entryField}.id`, `\u8D44\u6E90id\u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
      ids.add(id);
      validateValue(entry.value, `${entryField}.value`);
    });
    return ids;
  }
  function planSeries(resources, checkpointCount) {
    const series = assertArray(resources.series, "resources.series");
    const plans = [];
    const indexById = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    series.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const field = `resources.series[${index}]`;
      const version = assertRecord(raw, field);
      const id = assertString(version.id, `${field}.id`);
      if (indexById.has(id)) fail(`${field}.id`, `\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672Cid\u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
      indexById.set(id, index);
      const timeframe = assertEnum(version.timeframe, `${field}.timeframe`, TIMEFRAMES);
      const asOf = assertDateOrNull(version.asOf, `${field}.asOf`);
      const firstCheckpoint = assertInteger(version.firstCheckpoint, `${field}.firstCheckpoint`);
      if (firstCheckpoint < 0 || firstCheckpoint >= checkpointCount) {
        fail(`${field}.firstCheckpoint`, `\u987B\u662F\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u6570\u7EC4\u4E0B\u6807\uFF080..${checkpointCount - 1}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${firstCheckpoint}\uFF09`);
      }
      plans.push({ id, field, timeframe, asOf, firstCheckpoint, baseIndex: null, raw: version });
    });
    const depths = new Array(plans.length).fill(0);
    plans.forEach((plan, index) => {
      if (plan.raw.base === null) return;
      const baseId = assertString(plan.raw.base, `${plan.field}.base`);
      const baseIndex = indexById.get(baseId);
      if (baseIndex === void 0) fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\uFF08${baseId}\uFF09`);
      if (baseIndex >= index) fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u5FC5\u987B\u5148\u51FA\u73B0\uFF08${baseId} \u5728\u4E0B\u6807 ${baseIndex}\uFF0C\u5F53\u524D\u7248\u672C\u5728\u4E0B\u6807 ${index}\uFF09`);
      plan.baseIndex = baseIndex;
      const base = plans[baseIndex];
      if (base.timeframe !== plan.timeframe) {
        fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u5468\u671F\u5FC5\u987B\u4E00\u81F4\uFF08base ${base.timeframe}\uFF0C\u5F53\u524D ${plan.timeframe}\uFF09`);
      }
      if (base.firstCheckpoint > plan.firstCheckpoint) {
        fail(
          `${plan.field}.firstCheckpoint`,
          `\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672CfirstCheckpoint\uFF08${base.firstCheckpoint}\uFF09\u4E0D\u5F97\u665A\u4E8E\u6D3E\u751F\uFF08${plan.firstCheckpoint}\uFF09\uFF0C\u6D3E\u751F\u8FD8\u539F\u5305\u542B\u57FA\u7840\u5185\u5BB9`
        );
      }
      depths[index] = depths[baseIndex] + 1;
      if (depths[index] > MAX_DELTA_CHAIN2) {
        fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u589E\u91CF\u94FE\u6DF1 ${depths[index]} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DELTA_CHAIN2} \u5C42\uFF0C\u5FC5\u987B\u6539\u5B58\u65B0\u5168\u91CF\u57FA\u7840`);
      }
      if (base.asOf !== null && plan.asOf !== null && base.asOf > plan.asOf) {
        fail(`${plan.field}.asOf`, `\u57FA\u7840\u5DF2\u77E5asOf\u4E0D\u5F97\u665A\u4E8E\u6D3E\u751F\uFF08base ${base.asOf}\uFF0C\u5F53\u524D ${plan.asOf}\uFF09`);
      }
    });
    return plans;
  }
  function buildSeriesBaseState(plan, restoreBars) {
    const bars = assertArray(plan.raw.bars, `${plan.field}.bars`);
    if (bars.length > MAX_SERIES_BARS) {
      fail(`${plan.field}.bars`, `bar\u6570\u91CF ${bars.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_SERIES_BARS}`);
    }
    const dates = [];
    const posByKey = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    bars.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const date = assertBar(raw, `${plan.field}.bars[${index}]`, plan.timeframe);
      if (index > 0 && date <= dates[index - 1]) {
        fail(`${plan.field}.bars[${index}].date`, `\u5FC5\u987B\u4E25\u683C\u6309\u65E5\u671F\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u524D\u503C ${dates[index - 1]}\uFF0C\u6536\u5230 ${date}\uFF09`);
      }
      posByKey.set(raw.date, index);
      dates.push(date);
    });
    restoreBars.count += dates.length;
    return { dates, posByKey };
  }
  function applySeriesDelta(plan, parent, restoreBars) {
    const upsert = assertArray(plan.raw.upsert, `${plan.field}.upsert`);
    if (upsert.length > MAX_SERIES_BARS) {
      fail(`${plan.field}.upsert`, `upsert bar\u6570\u91CF ${upsert.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_SERIES_BARS}`);
    }
    const removes = assertArray(plan.raw.remove, `${plan.field}.remove`);
    const dates = parent.dates.slice();
    const posByKey = new Map(parent.posByKey);
    upsert.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const date = assertBar(raw, `${plan.field}.upsert[${index}]`, plan.timeframe);
      const key = raw.date;
      const at = posByKey.get(key);
      if (at === void 0) {
        posByKey.set(key, dates.length);
        dates.push(date);
      } else {
        dates[at] = date;
      }
    });
    if (removes.length > 0) {
      const drop = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      removes.forEach((key, index) => {
        const text = assertString(key, `${plan.field}.remove[${index}]`);
        if (drop.has(text)) fail(`${plan.field}.remove[${index}]`, `\u91CD\u590D\u7684\u79FB\u9664\u952E\uFF08${text}\uFF09`);
        drop.add(text);
      });
      const keptDates = [];
      const keptPos = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      for (const [key, at] of posByKey) {
        if (!drop.has(key)) {
          keptPos.set(key, keptDates.length);
          keptDates.push(dates[at]);
        }
      }
      dates.length = 0;
      dates.push(...keptDates);
      posByKey.clear();
      for (const [key, at] of keptPos) posByKey.set(key, at);
    }
    if (dates.length > MAX_SERIES_BARS) {
      fail(plan.field, `\u8FD8\u539F\u540Ebar\u6570\u91CF ${dates.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_SERIES_BARS}`);
    }
    restoreBars.count += dates.length + upsert.length + removes.length;
    dates.forEach((date, index) => {
      if (index > 0 && date <= dates[index - 1]) {
        fail(`${plan.field}`, `\u8FD8\u539F\u540Ebar\u65E5\u671F\u5FC5\u987B\u4E25\u683C\u9012\u589E\uFF08\u4F4D\u7F6E ${index - 1} \u4E3A ${dates[index - 1]}\uFF0C\u4F4D\u7F6E ${index} \u4E3A ${date}\uFF09`);
      }
    });
    return { dates, posByKey };
  }
  function resolveSeries(plans, resourceBars) {
    const restoreBars = { count: 0 };
    const pendingUses = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    plans.forEach((plan) => {
      if (plan.baseIndex !== null) pendingUses.set(plan.baseIndex, (pendingUses.get(plan.baseIndex) ?? 0) + 1);
    });
    const states = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const summaries = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    plans.forEach((plan, index) => {
      let state;
      if (plan.baseIndex === null) {
        state = buildSeriesBaseState(plan, restoreBars);
        resourceBars.count += plan.raw.bars.length;
      } else {
        const parent = states.get(plan.baseIndex);
        if (!parent) fail(plan.field, "\u5185\u90E8\u9519\u8BEF\uFF1A\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u72B6\u6001\u7F3A\u5931");
        state = applySeriesDelta(plan, parent, restoreBars);
        resourceBars.count += plan.raw.upsert.length;
        const used = (pendingUses.get(plan.baseIndex) ?? 1) - 1;
        if (used <= 0) {
          pendingUses.delete(plan.baseIndex);
          states.delete(plan.baseIndex);
        } else {
          pendingUses.set(plan.baseIndex, used);
        }
      }
      if (resourceBars.count > MAX_RESOURCE_BARS) {
        fail("resources.series", `\u5168\u8D44\u6E90Bar\u6761\u76EE ${resourceBars.count} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_RESOURCE_BARS}`);
      }
      if (restoreBars.count > MAX_RESTORE_BARS) {
        fail("resources.series", `\u6821\u9A8C\u671F\u7D2F\u8BA1\u8FD8\u539F ${restoreBars.count} \u6761Bar\u8D85\u8FC7\u9884\u7B97 ${MAX_RESTORE_BARS}\uFF08\u6309\u552F\u4E00\u7248\u672C\u8BA1\u8D39\uFF09`);
      }
      const asOf = plan.asOf;
      if (asOf !== null) {
        state.dates.forEach((date, position) => {
          if (date > asOf) {
            fail(`${plan.field}`, `\u8FD8\u539F\u540E\u5305\u542B\u665A\u4E8EasOf\uFF08${asOf}\uFF09\u7684bar\uFF08\u4F4D\u7F6E ${position} \u65E5\u671F ${date}\uFF09\uFF0C\u4E0D\u5F97\u56DE\u586B\u672A\u6765\u884C\u60C5`);
          }
        });
      }
      if (pendingUses.has(index)) states.set(index, state);
      summaries.set(plan.id, { timeframe: plan.timeframe, asOf: plan.asOf, firstCheckpoint: plan.firstCheckpoint });
    });
    return { summaries, restoreBars: restoreBars.count };
  }
  function planDrawings(resources) {
    const drawings = assertArray(resources.drawings, "resources.drawings");
    const indexById = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const plans = [];
    drawings.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const field = `resources.drawings[${index}]`;
      const version = assertRecord(raw, field);
      const id = assertString(version.id, `${field}.id`);
      if (indexById.has(id)) fail(`${field}.id`, `\u753B\u7EBF\u7248\u672Cid\u91CD\u590D\uFF08${id}\uFF09`);
      indexById.set(id, index);
      let ownIds;
      let removes;
      if (version.base === null) {
        const items = assertArray(version.items, `${field}.items`);
        if (items.length > MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS) {
          fail(`${field}.items`, `\u753B\u7EBF\u6570\u91CF ${items.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS}`);
        }
        ownIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
        items.forEach((item, itemIndex) => assertDrawing(item, `${field}.items[${itemIndex}]`, ownIds));
        removes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      } else {
        const upsert = assertArray(version.upsert, `${field}.upsert`);
        if (upsert.length > MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS) {
          fail(`${field}.upsert`, `upsert\u753B\u7EBF\u6570\u91CF ${upsert.length} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS}`);
        }
        ownIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
        upsert.forEach((item, itemIndex) => assertDrawing(item, `${field}.upsert[${itemIndex}]`, ownIds));
        removes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
        const removeKeys = assertArray(version.remove, `${field}.remove`);
        removeKeys.forEach((key, keyIndex) => {
          const text = assertString(key, `${field}.remove[${keyIndex}]`);
          if (removes.has(text)) fail(`${field}.remove[${keyIndex}]`, `\u91CD\u590D\u7684\u79FB\u9664\u952E\uFF08${text}\uFF09`);
          removes.add(text);
        });
      }
      plans.push({ id, field, baseIndex: null, ownIds, removes, raw: version });
    });
    const depths = new Array(plans.length).fill(0);
    const restoredSets = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const pendingUses = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    plans.forEach((plan) => {
      if (typeof plan.raw.base !== "string") return;
      const baseIndex = indexById.get(plan.raw.base);
      if (baseIndex === void 0) return;
      pendingUses.set(baseIndex, (pendingUses.get(baseIndex) ?? 0) + 1);
    });
    plans.forEach((plan, index) => {
      let restored;
      if (plan.raw.base === null) {
        restored = plan.ownIds;
      } else {
        const baseId = assertString(plan.raw.base, `${plan.field}.base`);
        const baseIndex = indexById.get(baseId);
        if (baseIndex === void 0) fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u4E0D\u5B58\u5728\uFF08${baseId}\uFF09`);
        if (baseIndex >= index) fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u57FA\u7840\u7248\u672C\u5FC5\u987B\u5148\u51FA\u73B0\uFF08${baseId} \u5728\u4E0B\u6807 ${baseIndex}\uFF0C\u5F53\u524D\u7248\u672C\u5728\u4E0B\u6807 ${index}\uFF09`);
        plan.baseIndex = baseIndex;
        depths[index] = depths[baseIndex] + 1;
        if (depths[index] > MAX_DELTA_CHAIN2) {
          fail(`${plan.field}.base`, `\u589E\u91CF\u94FE\u6DF1 ${depths[index]} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DELTA_CHAIN2} \u5C42\uFF0C\u5FC5\u987B\u6539\u5B58\u65B0\u5168\u91CF\u57FA\u7840`);
        }
        const parent = restoredSets.get(baseIndex);
        if (!parent) fail(plan.field, "\u5185\u90E8\u9519\u8BEF\uFF1A\u57FA\u7840\u753B\u7EBF\u96C6\u5408\u7F3A\u5931");
        restored = new Set(parent);
        plan.removes.forEach((key) => restored.delete(key));
        plan.ownIds.forEach((owned) => restored.add(owned));
        if (restored.size > MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS) {
          fail(plan.field, `\u8FD8\u539F\u540E\u753B\u7EBF\u6570\u91CF ${restored.size} \u8D85\u8FC7\u4E0A\u9650 ${MAX_DRAWING_ITEMS}`);
        }
        const used = (pendingUses.get(baseIndex) ?? 1) - 1;
        if (used <= 0) {
          pendingUses.delete(baseIndex);
          restoredSets.delete(baseIndex);
        } else {
          pendingUses.set(baseIndex, used);
        }
      }
      if (pendingUses.has(index)) restoredSets.set(index, restored);
    });
    return indexById;
  }
  function validateCompactRecording(value) {
    if (!isRecord(value)) fail("\u9876\u5C42", "\u5FC5\u987B\u662F JSON \u5BF9\u8C61");
    assertJson(value, "", 1);
    if (value.format !== "trainer-session") {
      fail("format", `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F 'trainer-session'\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(value.format)}\uFF09`);
    }
    const allowRange = value.schemaVersion === 3;
    if (value.schemaVersion !== 2 && value.schemaVersion !== 3) {
      fail("schemaVersion", `\u5FC5\u987B\u662F 2 \u6216 3\uFF08\u6536\u5230 ${JSON.stringify(value.schemaVersion)}\uFF09`);
    }
    assertString(value.sessionId, "sessionId");
    assertTimestamp(value.createdAt, "createdAt");
    assertAppAndEnvironment(value);
    assertStringOrNull(value.trainingKey, "trainingKey");
    assertBoolean(value.complete, "complete");
    const { events, refs, segmentIds } = assertEvents(value);
    const checkpointIds = assertCompactCheckpoints(value, events.length, segmentIds);
    assertEventCheckpointRefs(refs, checkpointIds);
    assertGaps(value, events.length);
    const resourcesRaw = assertRecord(value.resources, "resources");
    const checkpoints = value.checkpoints;
    const metaIds = assertValueTable(resourcesRaw.trainingMeta, "resources.trainingMeta", (meta, field) => {
      assertTrainingMeta(meta, field, { allowRange });
    });
    const accountIds = assertValueTable(resourcesRaw.accounts, "resources.accounts", (account, field) => {
      assertAccountView(account, field);
    });
    const tradeIds = assertValueTable(resourcesRaw.trades, "resources.trades", (trade, field) => {
      assertTrade(trade, field);
    });
    const contextIds = assertValueTable(resourcesRaw.contexts, "resources.contexts", () => {
    });
    const metaCutoffs = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    resourcesRaw.trainingMeta.forEach((entryRaw) => {
      const entry = entryRaw;
      const meta = entry.value;
      metaCutoffs.set(entry.id, {
        currentDate: meta.currentDate ?? null,
        blind: Boolean(meta.blind),
        startDate: meta.startDate
      });
    });
    const seriesPlans = planSeries(resourcesRaw, checkpoints.length);
    const drawingIds = planDrawings(resourcesRaw);
    const resourceBars = { count: 0 };
    const { summaries } = resolveSeries(seriesPlans, resourceBars);
    checkpoints.forEach((raw, index) => {
      const checkpoint = raw;
      if (checkpoint.training !== null) {
        const training = checkpoint.training;
        if (!metaIds.has(training.metaRef)) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].training.metaRef`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5143\u6570\u636E ${training.metaRef} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
        }
        if (!accountIds.has(training.accountRef)) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].training.accountRef`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u8D26\u6237\u89C6\u56FE ${training.accountRef} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
        }
        training.tradeRefs.forEach((ref, tradeIndex) => {
          if (!tradeIds.has(ref)) {
            fail(`checkpoints[${index}].training.tradeRefs[${tradeIndex}]`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u6210\u4EA4\u89C6\u56FE ${ref} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
          }
        });
      }
      if (checkpoint.chart !== null) {
        const chart = checkpoint.chart;
        const summary = summaries.get(chart.seriesRef);
        if (!summary) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].chart.seriesRef`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672C ${chart.seriesRef} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
        } else {
          if (chart.timeframe !== summary.timeframe) {
            fail(
              `checkpoints[${index}].chart.timeframe`,
              `\u5468\u671F\u987B\u4E0E\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672C\u4E00\u81F4\uFF08chart ${String(chart.timeframe)}\uFF0C\u7248\u672C ${summary.timeframe}\uFF09`
            );
          }
          if (index < summary.firstCheckpoint) {
            fail(
              `checkpoints[${index}].chart.seriesRef`,
              `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672C firstCheckpoint=${summary.firstCheckpoint} \u665A\u4E8E\u5F53\u524D\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u4E0B\u6807 ${index}\uFF0C\u4E0D\u5F97\u56DE\u586B\u672A\u6765\u6B65\u9AA4`
            );
          }
          if (checkpoint.training !== null) {
            const training = checkpoint.training;
            const meta = metaCutoffs.get(training.metaRef);
            if (meta) {
              const cutoff = deriveCutoff(meta);
              if (cutoff !== null) {
                if (summary.asOf === null) {
                  fail(`checkpoints[${index}].chart.seriesRef`, `\u5DF2\u77E5\u622A\u6B62\uFF08${cutoff}\uFF09\u7684\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u4E0D\u5F97\u5F15\u7528asOf=null\u7684\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672C ${chart.seriesRef}`);
                } else if (summary.asOf > cutoff) {
                  fail(`checkpoints[${index}].chart.seriesRef`, `\u884C\u60C5\u7248\u672CasOf\uFF08${summary.asOf}\uFF09\u665A\u4E8E\u68C0\u67E5\u70B9\u622A\u6B62\uFF08${cutoff}\uFF09\uFF0C\u4E0D\u5F97\u5F15\u7528\u672A\u6765\u884C\u60C5`);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (!drawingIds.has(chart.drawingsRef)) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].chart.drawingsRef`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u753B\u7EBF\u7248\u672C ${chart.drawingsRef} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
        }
      }
      if (checkpoint.contextRef !== null) {
        const contextRef = checkpoint.contextRef;
        if (!contextIds.has(contextRef)) {
          fail(`checkpoints[${index}].contextRef`, `\u5F15\u7528\u7684\u8BAD\u7EC3context ${contextRef} \u4E0D\u5B58\u5728`);
        }
      }
    });
    return value;
  }

  // web/src/recording/storage.ts
  var RECORDING_DB_NAME = "trainer-recordings";
  var recordingDbName = RECORDING_DB_NAME;
  function configureRecordingDbNamespace(namespace) {
    const value = namespace.trim();
    if (!value) throw new Error("\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93\u547D\u540D\u7A7A\u95F4\u4E3A\u7A7A\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u8BBF\u95EE\u672A\u9694\u79BB\u7684\u672C\u673A\u5F55\u50CF");
    const safe = value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "-").slice(0, 96);
    recordingDbName = `${RECORDING_DB_NAME}.${safe}`;
  }
  function getRecordingDbName() {
    return recordingDbName;
  }

  // tools/migrate-v127/src/export-core.ts
  var LEGACY_MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 2e4;
  var MIGRATION_BUNDLE_FORMAT = "trainer-recordings-bundle";
  var MIGRATION_BUNDLE_VERSION = 1;
  var RESOURCE_KINDS = ["series", "drawings", "trainingMeta", "accounts", "trades", "contexts"];
  var RECORD_KINDS = ["event", "checkpoint", ...RESOURCE_KINDS];
  function entryIdentityOf(kind, value) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
    const id = value[kind === "event" ? "opId" : "id"];
    return typeof id === "string" && id !== "" ? id : null;
  }
  function countsKeyOf(kind) {
    return kind === "event" ? "events" : kind === "checkpoint" ? "checkpoints" : kind;
  }
  function assembleCompactSession(header, rows) {
    const sessionId = String(header.sessionId ?? "");
    const counts = header.counts ?? {};
    const byKind = new Map(RECORD_KINDS.map((kind) => [kind, /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()]));
    for (const row of rows) {
      const kind = row.kind;
      const bucket = byKind.get(kind);
      if (!bucket) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A\u5B58\u5728\u672A\u77E5 kind\u300C${String(row.kind)}\u300D\u7684\u8BB0\u5F55\u884C\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      if (entryIdentityOf(kind, row.value) === null) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A${kind} #${String(row.index)} \u7684\u6761\u76EE\u7F3A\u5C11\u5408\u6CD5 id/opId\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      const index = row.index;
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(index) || index < 0) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A${kind} \u884C\u4E0B\u6807 ${String(row.index)} \u975E\u6CD5\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      if (bucket.has(index)) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A${kind} #${index} \u51FA\u73B0\u91CD\u590D\u884C\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      bucket.set(index, row.value);
    }
    for (const kind of RECORD_KINDS) {
      const bucket = byKind.get(kind);
      const count = counts[countsKeyOf(kind)];
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 0) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1Aheader.counts.${countsKeyOf(kind)} \u975E\u6CD5\uFF08${String(count)}\uFF09\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      if (bucket.size !== count) {
        throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A${kind} \u884C\u6570 ${bucket.size} \u4E0E header.counts ${count} \u4E0D\u4E00\u81F4\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
      }
      for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
        if (!bucket.has(index)) {
          throw new Error(`\u4F1A\u8BDD ${sessionId} \u6301\u4E45\u8BB0\u5F55\u635F\u574F\uFF1A${kind} \u7F3A\u5C11\u4E0B\u6807 ${index} \u7684\u8BB0\u5F55\u884C\uFF08counts=${count}\uFF09\uFF0C\u62D2\u7EDD\u52A0\u8F7D\u3002`);
        }
      }
    }
    const resources = {};
    for (const kind of RESOURCE_KINDS) {
      const list = [];
      const bucket = byKind.get(kind);
      const count = counts[kind];
      for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) list.push(bucket.get(index));
      resources[kind] = list;
    }
    const events = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < counts.events; index++) events.push(byKind.get("event").get(index));
    const checkpoints = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < counts.checkpoints; index++) checkpoints.push(byKind.get("checkpoint").get(index));
    return {
      format: "trainer-session",
      schemaVersion: header.schemaVersion,
      sessionId,
      createdAt: header.createdAt,
      app: header.app,
      environment: header.environment,
      trainingKey: header.trainingKey ?? null,
      events,
      checkpoints,
      gaps: header.gaps,
      complete: header.complete,
      resources
    };
  }
  function convertLegacySession(raw) {
    try {
      const legacy = validateRecording(raw, { maxCheckpoints: LEGACY_MAX_CHECKPOINTS });
      const migrated = compactRecording(legacy);
      return { ok: true, file: validateCompactRecording(migrated) };
    } catch (error) {
      return { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) };
    }
  }
  function idb() {
    const scope = globalThis;
    if (!scope.indexedDB) throw new Error("\u5F53\u524D\u73AF\u5883\u4E0D\u652F\u6301 IndexedDB\uFF0C\u65E0\u6CD5\u8BFB\u53D6\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5F55\u50CF\u3002");
    return scope.indexedDB;
  }
  function trainerDbNameFor(namespace) {
    configureRecordingDbNamespace(namespace);
    return getRecordingDbName();
  }
  function openExistingDatabase(name) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let request;
      try {
        request = idb().open(name);
      } catch {
        resolve(null);
        return;
      }
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const db = request.result;
        if (db.version === 1 && db.objectStoreNames.length === 0) {
          db.close();
          try {
            void idb().deleteDatabase(name);
          } catch {
          }
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        resolve({ db, version: db.version, storeNames: [...db.objectStoreNames] });
      };
      request.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    });
  }
  function waitRequest(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error ?? new Error("IndexedDB \u8BF7\u6C42\u5931\u8D25"));
    });
  }
  function waitTransaction(tx) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error ?? new Error("IndexedDB \u4E8B\u52A1\u5931\u8D25"));
      tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error ?? new Error("IndexedDB \u4E8B\u52A1\u5DF2\u4E2D\u6B62"));
    });
  }
  async function readAll(db, storeName, range) {
    const tx = db.transaction([storeName], "readonly");
    const pending = waitRequest(tx.objectStore(storeName).getAll(range));
    await waitTransaction(tx);
    return pending;
  }
  function sessionRange(sessionId) {
    return IDBKeyRange.bound([sessionId, ""], [sessionId, "\uFFFF"]);
  }
  function summaryOf(payload, source, note) {
    return {
      sessionId: String(payload.sessionId ?? "(\u672A\u77E5)"),
      source,
      eventCount: Array.isArray(payload.events) ? payload.events.length : 0,
      createdAt: payload.createdAt ?? "",
      trainingKey: typeof payload.trainingKey === "string" ? payload.trainingKey : null,
      note
    };
  }
  async function collectMigrationItems(main, imports) {
    const outcome = { items: [], summaries: [], failures: [] };
    const has = (opened, store) => opened.storeNames.includes(store);
    const headers = has(main, "compactSessions") ? await readAll(main.db, "compactSessions") : [];
    const legacyFiles = has(main, "sessions") ? await readAll(main.db, "sessions") : [];
    const compactIds = new Set(headers.map((header) => String(header.sessionId)));
    for (const header of headers) {
      const sessionId = String(header.sessionId ?? "");
      try {
        const rows = has(main, "compactRecords") ? await readAll(main.db, "compactRecords", sessionId ? sessionRange(sessionId) : void 0) : [];
        const assembled = assembleCompactSession(header, rows);
        try {
          outcome.items.push(validateCompactRecording(assembled));
          outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(assembled, "local-compact"));
        } catch (error) {
          outcome.items.push(assembled);
          outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(assembled, "local-compact", `\u6821\u9A8C\u5931\u8D25\u539F\u6837\u5165\u5305\uFF1A${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        outcome.failures.push({ sessionId, reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
      }
    }
    for (const legacy of legacyFiles) {
      const sessionId = String(legacy.sessionId ?? "");
      if (compactIds.has(sessionId)) continue;
      const converted = convertLegacySession(legacy);
      if (converted.ok) {
        outcome.items.push(converted.file);
        outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(converted.file, "local-legacy", "\u65E7 v1 \u683C\u5F0F\u5DF2\u8F6C\u6362\u4E3A v2"));
      } else {
        outcome.items.push(legacy);
        outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(legacy, "local-legacy-raw", `\u8F6C\u6362\u5931\u8D25\u539F\u6837\u5165\u5305\uFF1A${converted.error}`));
      }
    }
    if (imports) {
      if (has(imports, "recordings")) {
        const stored = await readAll(imports.db, "recordings");
        for (const recording of stored) {
          try {
            outcome.items.push(validateCompactRecording(recording));
            outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(recording, "imported"));
          } catch (error) {
            outcome.items.push(recording);
            outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(recording, "imported-raw", `\u6821\u9A8C\u5931\u8D25\u539F\u6837\u5165\u5305\uFF1A${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`));
          }
        }
      } else if (has(imports, "imports")) {
        const entries = await readAll(imports.db, "imports");
        for (const entry of entries) {
          const recording = entry.recording;
          if (!recording || typeof recording !== "object") {
            outcome.failures.push({ sessionId: String(entry.sessionId ?? "(\u672A\u77E5)"), reason: "\u65E7\u5BFC\u5165\u8BB0\u5F55\u7F3A\u5C11 recording \u8F7D\u8377" });
            continue;
          }
          try {
            outcome.items.push(validateCompactRecording(recording));
            outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(recording, "imported"));
          } catch (error) {
            outcome.items.push(recording);
            outcome.summaries.push(summaryOf(recording, "imported-raw", `\u6821\u9A8C\u5931\u8D25\u539F\u6837\u5165\u5305\uFF1A${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`));
          }
        }
      }
    }
    outcome.summaries.sort((a, b) => String(a.createdAt).localeCompare(String(b.createdAt)));
    return outcome;
  }
  function buildMigrationBundle(items, now = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
    if (!items.length) throw new Error("\u5E93\u4E2D\u6CA1\u6709\u5F55\u50CF\uFF0C\u65E0\u6CD5\u5BFC\u51FA\u5408\u5E76\u5305");
    return {
      format: MIGRATION_BUNDLE_FORMAT,
      version: MIGRATION_BUNDLE_VERSION,
      exportedAt: now.toISOString(),
      items
    };
  }
  function migrationBundleFileName(now = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
    const pad = (value) => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
    const stamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}`;
    return `\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93-${stamp}.trainer-recordings.json`;
  }
  function downloadMigrationBundle(bundle) {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(bundle)], { type: "application/json" });
    const fileName = migrationBundleFileName();
    const anchor = document.createElement("a");
    anchor.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    anchor.download = fileName;
    document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(anchor.href), 6e4);
    return { blob, fileName };
  }

  // tools/migrate-v127/src/console-fallback.ts
  function log(text) {
    console.log(`[\u5F55\u50CF\u8FC1\u79FB] ${text}`);
  }
  async function run() {
    const response = await fetch("/api/env");
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`\u8BFB\u53D6 /api/env \u5931\u8D25\uFF08HTTP ${response.status}\uFF09\u2014\u2014\u8BF7\u786E\u8BA4\u672C\u9875\u9762\u5C31\u662F\u6B63\u5728\u8FD0\u884C\u7684\u65E7\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5668\u9875\u9762`);
    const env = await response.json();
    if (!env.recordingNamespace) throw new Error("/api/env \u672A\u8FD4\u56DE recordingNamespace\uFF0C\u65E0\u6CD5\u5B9A\u4F4D\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93");
    const dbName = trainerDbNameFor(env.recordingNamespace);
    const main = await openExistingDatabase(dbName);
    if (!main) throw new Error(`\u672A\u627E\u5230\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93 ${dbName}\u2014\u2014\u672C\u6D4F\u89C8\u5668\u5730\u5740\u4E0B\u6CA1\u6709\u65E7\u5F55\u50CF\uFF0C\u8BF7\u786E\u8BA4\u7528\u7684\u662F\u5F53\u65F6\u7684\u6D4F\u89C8\u5668`);
    const imports = await openExistingDatabase(`${dbName}.imports`);
    try {
      log(`\u8BFB\u53D6\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93 ${dbName}\uFF08\u7248\u672C ${main.version}\uFF09\u2026`);
      const scan = await collectMigrationItems(main, imports);
      if (!scan.items.length) {
        log("\u5F55\u50CF\u5E93\u4E3A\u7A7A\uFF0C\u6CA1\u6709\u53EF\u5BFC\u51FA\u7684\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5F55\u50CF\u3002");
        return;
      }
      const bundle = buildMigrationBundle(scan.items);
      const { blob, fileName } = downloadMigrationBundle(bundle);
      log(`\u5DF2\u89E6\u53D1\u4E0B\u8F7D\uFF1A${fileName}\uFF08${(blob.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB\uFF0C\u5171 ${scan.items.length} \u6761\u5F55\u50CF\uFF09\u3002`);
      for (const row of scan.summaries) {
        log(`\xB7 ${row.sessionId} \u4E8B\u4EF6 ${row.eventCount}${row.note ? `\uFF08${row.note}\uFF09` : ""}`);
      }
      if (scan.failures.length) {
        console.warn(`[\u5F55\u50CF\u8FC1\u79FB] ${scan.failures.length} \u573A\u5B58\u50A8\u635F\u574F\u65E0\u6CD5\u5BFC\u51FA\uFF1A`);
        for (const failure of scan.failures) console.warn(`[\u5F55\u50CF\u8FC1\u79FB] \xB7 ${failure.sessionId}\uFF1A${failure.reason}`);
      }
      log("\u4E0B\u4E00\u6B65\uFF1A\u6253\u5F00 v1.3.0 \u2192\u300C\u8BAD\u7EC3\u5F55\u50CF\u300D\u2192\u300C\u5BFC\u5165\u5F55\u5236\u300D\uFF0C\u9009\u62E9\u521A\u4E0B\u8F7D\u7684\u5408\u5E76\u5305\u6587\u4EF6\u3002");
    } finally {
      main.db.close();
      imports?.db.close();
    }
  }
  void run().catch((error) => {
    console.error(`[\u5F55\u50CF\u8FC1\u79FB] \u5BFC\u51FA\u5931\u8D25\uFF1A${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  });
})();
